data.other_hard: Candidates must have an excellent academic background and show considerable promise.
data.evidence_sentence: The scholarship is open to candidates from all nationalities, although priority is given to applicants of Lebanese descent.
data.notes: Page is for the Cambridge MBA scholarship from Boustany Foundation; priority to applicants of Lebanese descent is a preference, not a requirement. Scholars must complete a two-month internship in Monaco, which is a condition of the award but not a study location. Field of study not stated. Award amount not stated, so funding_type is empty. Verbal academic requirement 'excellent academic background' is not a numeric GPA, so min_gpa is empty; it is recorded in other_hard.
